Markets.title: Nasdaq futures rise as tech stocks firm up ahead of Nvidia results, Anthropic IPO: Stock Market Live Updates
Markets.summary: Nasdaq futures increased as technology stocks strengthened in anticipation of Nvidia's upcoming financial results and an Anthropic initial public offering. Investors closely monitored these developments during live stock market updates.

Markets.title: Centricity WealthTech launches private clients business for NRIs
Markets.summary: Centricity WealthTech has launched a global private clients business tailored for NRIs and hired over 40 private bankers. The company aims to generate Rs 60 crore in revenue by 2027-28 and expects to reach Rs 400 crore annually within four years after the launch.

Markets.title: M3M India to invest Rs 1,650 cr to build luxury homes under Jacob & Co brand in Gurugram
Markets.summary: M3M India is investing Rs 1,650 crore to build M3M Jacob & Co Residences in Gurugram's Sector 111. The luxury project will feature 120 apartments measuring about 7,300 square feet each, with prices starting at Rs 26 crore.

Markets.title: Indian bonds surge after oil slide eases aggressive rate hike concerns
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds rallied on Tuesday as falling oil prices reduced concerns about aggressive interest rate hikes and inflation. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond dropped to 7.2528% from 7.3169% the previous day.

Markets.title: Eternal among 5 stocks hitting 52-week highs; stock rallies up to 15% in a month
Markets.summary: On Tuesday, Eternal, DLF, Kotak Mahindra Bank, and two other BSE 100 stocks reached new 52-week highs. Eternal led the group with a 15% price rally over the past month.

Markets.title: Disney beats earnings forecasts, plans to increase content spending
Markets.summary: Walt Disney reported increased quarterly revenue and earnings driven by higher theme park attendance and NFL broadcasts. The company plans to raise its next fiscal year content budget to $26 billion and increase its dividend by 33% to $2 per share.

Geo-Political.title: Putin's Crimea bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian attack caused a partial collapse of the strategic bridge connecting Russia to Crimea. The Kremlin has vowed to rebuild the structure following the incident.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian officials report that ongoing Russian strikes are hindering efforts to recover bodies following a double-tap attack in southern Ukraine. This recent escalation of strikes has led to accusations that Russia is deliberately targeting the rescue operations.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
Geo-Political.summary: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fire...

Geo-Political.title: Nvidia partner Megaspeed being investigated by US government over chip exports
Geo-Political.summary: The US government is investigating Singapore-based Megaspeed for allegedly violating export rules by shipping high-end Nvidia AI chips to China. Megaspeed is an official partner of Nvidia.

Geo-Political.title: Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed
Geo-Political.summary: Bilkis Bano expressed shock and heartbreak after India's Supreme Court granted bail to two men convicted of gang-raping her during the 2002 Gujarat riots. Bano vowed to continue her legal fight against the court's decision.

Geo-Political.title: Imran Khan seeks urgent medical care fearing he 'may not return alive'
Geo-Political.summary: Imprisoned former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan is urgently requesting medical care, expressing fear for his life. Khan has been detained since August 2023 and claims he is being denied justice.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code to reverse engineer apps, games, and features.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to help creators improve their digital content in 2025. It explains how these technologies are revolutionizing the content creation process and making creators' workflows more efficient.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate tasks, improve workflows, and boost productivity across various industries. These widely used market solutions cater to a diverse range of business and technical applications.

AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audiences. With many different options currently available on the market, choosing the right AI writing tool can be difficult.

Data & Insights.title: Could AI boom trigger a jobs crisis? The risks Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sees beyond productivity gains
Data & Insights.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warns that the AI boom could cause widespread job displacement through automation or trigger an economic slowdown if market expectations fail to be met. Conversely, he also notes that AI could drive faster economic growth through productivity gains.

Data & Insights.title: Union Budget 2027-28: FICCI seeks graded LTCG taxation,  ₹100 lakh crore in credit for manufacturing growth
Data & Insights.summary: FICCI has recommended restoring the long-term capital gains tax exemption on listed securities for the Union Budget 2027-28. The industry body is also advocating for a calibrated increase in the securities transaction tax.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: What FM's pre-budget stakeholder consultations mean
Data & Insights.summary: Over the next few days, finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman will huddle with industry executives, bankers, capital marke...

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027: Economists oppose LTCG tax cut as industry seeks abolition; what they told Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of Budget 2027-28, economists advised Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to retain the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax on equities. This recommendation directly opposes the industry's demand for the complete abolition of the tax.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027-28: Govt to invite Gen Z for pre-Budget consultations; Sitharaman meets economists
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has started pre-Budget consultations with economists for the Union Budget 2027-28

Data & Insights.title: Centre hikes windfall tax on diesel, ATF exports; petrol levy unchanged — Check details
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has increased the windfall tax on exports of diesel and Aviation Turbine Fuel. Meanwhile, the export levy on petrol remains unchanged following this latest revision.

India.title: Ukrainian 'Scamster' Being Extradited From Romania In Major Breakthrough
India.summary: Romania is extraditing wanted Ukrainian national Oleksandr Zapichenko to India. He is accused of involvement in a 2025 money laundering and investment fraud case in Mumbai known as the Torres jewellery case.

India.title: GRAP III Curbs Revoked In Delhi-NCR As Air Quality Improves
India.summary: Air quality in Delhi-NCR has improved, leading to the revocation of GRAP III restrictions. These curbs had been initially invoked on November 7 due to a sharp drop in air quality.

India.title: States To Nandan Nilekani Task Force: Give Weightage To Class 12 Marks In NEET Exam
India.summary: States have urged a union government task force led by Nandan Nilekani to give weightage to Class 12 marks in the NEET medical entrance exam. The task force was established to recommend reforms regarding the security and conduct of public examinations.

India.title: Video: Speeding Bus Runs Over Group Helping Intoxicated Man On Punjab Road
India.summary: A speeding bus ran over a group of men who were trying to help an intoxicated man lying on a Punjab road. The incident, which occurred on Ludhiana's Machhiwara-Kuhara road, was captured on video.

India.title: Abhishek Banerjee Faces Contempt Over Remarks Against Calcutta High Court
India.summary: Abhishek Banerjee is facing contempt proceedings over his remarks against the Calcutta High Court. Additionally, the court ordered the West Bengal government to review the Diamond Harbour MP's security cover.

India.title: Punjab Congress Chief Pargat Singh Challanges "One Family, One Ticket" Rule
India.summary: Punjab Congress Chief Pargat Singh has opposed the party's "one family, one ticket" rule. He argued that blanket restrictions should not apply when one family member is a Member of Parliament and another seeks an assembly ticket.

General.title: Watch: What's in the Milburn review?
General.summary: A government-backed review proposes changes to tax, welfare, and education. These changes aim to help get young people into work.

General.title: At a glance: Key proposals from Milburn's Neets report
General.summary: A major UK review has proposed widespread changes to help young people find employment. The report outlines key measures designed to address the issue of youth unemployment.

General.title: Why Milburn's Neets reforms will only save £200m a year by 2036
General.summary: Alan Milburn's proposed reforms for young people not in education, employment, or training (Neets) are projected to save only £200 million annually by 2036. BBC Verify analyzed the government figures behind these welfare savings and found the financial impact will take over a decade to reach this total.

General.title: Where are the most jobs for 18-24 year-olds?
General.summary: This news story examines the local job availability and specific employment sectors offering the most opportunities. It helps young adults identify where jobs are located and which industries are actively hiring.

General.title: Putin's Crimea bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
General.summary: President Zelensky praised an unprecedented Ukrainian attack that partially collapsed the strategic Crimea bridge. The Kremlin stated that the structure will be rebuilt, while Ukrainian officials noted the strike required weeks of planning.

General.title: How Met failed to stop rape-unit detective who abused women
General.summary: Warren Arter used his position as the head of a Met Police sexual assault investigation team to target and abuse women. The Metropolitan Police failed to stop his criminal actions against these victims.
